entities.summary: Universiti Malaysia Pahang Al-Sultan Abdullah, abbreviated as UMPSA, is a public technical university in Pahang, Malaysia. UMPSA was founded as University College of Engineering and Technology Malaysia, abbreviated as UTEC or KUKTEM.
